description: Mechanical backstop for a subset of the TypeScript Patterns Enforcer rules (no any, @ts-ignore without a description, magic numbers, .then() chains, switch statements, parameter mutation, raw loops, nested ternaries, narrative-style comments, regexes without an example-and-tester-link comment). Self-contained — never reads or writes the target repo's own ESLint/tsconfig. At Stop, re-checks TypeScript files changed this session, including files written through a shell that the edit hook never sees (advisory). Degrades silently to prose-only enforcement if Node isn't available.
